plan.title: Create Single-Stage RFP from Service PR

steps.note: Enable eRFX project creation for the tenant.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation and keep Publish available.
Provide the required event title before publishing.
Assert that the RFP create screen does not show a pricing column.
Add the two vendors named in the case to the event.
Commit the 30-minute schedule while keeping the event starting now.
Publish the completed single-stage RFP and confirm the publish flow.
Assert that publishing reached a real project page.
Assert that Recreate Order is greyed out for an event created from a PR.
